decision.explanation: Conflicting dates for the establishment of the Cross of Liberty appear in the documents: 24 February 1919 and 12 March 1920 refer to the Estonian Cross of Liberty, while March 4, 1918 refers to the Finnish Order of the Cross of Liberty. These are distinct entities, so all three dates are included as independently justified.
